name: Cline Memory Bank
desc: memory-bank/ directory of Markdown: projectBrief.md , productContext.md , activeContext.md , systemPatterns.md , techContext.md , progress.md . Loaded in full at start of every task. Compensates for context-window reset between sessions.
deployment: not applicable — not a deployable product
pricing: not applicable — not commercial

name: Continue.dev .continue/rules
desc: .continue/rules/*.md at workspace root, loaded lexicographically; YAML frontmatter name, globs, regex, description, alwaysApply. Continue was acquired by Cursor in June 2026 and the extension is no longer maintained.
deployment: not applicable — not a deployable product
pricing: not applicable — not commercial

name: Cursor Rules
desc: Persistent instructions injected at start of model context: Project Rules (.mdc files in .cursor/rules, scoped Always/Auto Attached/Agent Requested/Manual), global User Rules, and AGENTS.md; legacy .cursorrules deprecated. Codebase indexing is separate from rules.
deployment: not applicable — not a deployable product
pricing: not applicable — not commercial

name: GitHub Copilot custom instructions
desc: .github/copilot-instructions.md (repo-wide) plus .github/instructions/*.instructions.md path-scoped via applyTo glob (optional excludeAgent); Copilot agents also honor AGENTS.md (nearest in tree) or a root CLAUDE.md/GEMINI.md.
deployment: not applicable — GitHub-hosted; no separate deployment
pricing: not applicable — file pattern included in GitHub Copilot subscription ($10/mo individual; $19/mo business)
license: n/a — feature of GitHub Copilot (proprietary); instructions files are user-owned

name: OpenClaw memory
desc: Memory system of the viral OpenClaw personal agent: plain Markdown files (USER.md, MEMORY.md, daily memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md notes, DREAMS.md) with memory_search/memory_get tools, automatic pre-compaction flush and a 'dreaming' sweep that distils daily notes into long-term memory; pluggable engines (LanceDB, Honcho, wiki). Traction: ~392k GitHub stars; spawned an ecosystem of memory plugins (memory-la
deployment: searched not found
pricing: searched not found

name: Replit replit.md
desc: replit.md at project root. Persists project overview, tech stack, architectural decisions, deployment process, external resources. Scoped to Agent conversations only.
deployment: not applicable — not a deployable product
pricing: not applicable — not commercial

name: Roo Code .roorules
desc: Discontinued: Roo Code (VS Code agent) used .roorules / .roo/rules files as persistent project instructions; the extension shut down on 2026-05-15 and its repo is archived.
deployment: not applicable — not a deployable product
pricing: not applicable — not commercial

name: Sourcegraph Cody — cody.json
desc: Cody Free, Pro and Enterprise Starter were discontinued 2025-07-23 (Amp offered as replacement); only Cody Enterprise continues. .vscode/cody.json (workspace-scoped). JSON defining slash-commands with prompt text, context options ( currentFile , openTabs , terminal ), and mode ( ask / edit / insert ). Reusable prompt templates for project-specific workflows; checked in for team sharing.
deployment: not applicable — not a deployable product
pricing: not applicable — not commercial

name: Windsurf Rules & Memories (now Devin Desktop)
desc: Now Devin Desktop (ex-Windsurf). Rules: global_rules.md (6K chars) plus workspace rules in .devin/rules/ (fallback .windsurf/rules/, 12K chars each) and AGENTS.md via the same engine. Cascade auto-memories stored in ~/.codeium/windsurf/memories/ are legacy-agent only, with a migration path to skills.
deployment: not applicable — not a deployable product
pricing: not applicable — not commercial

name: Zed .rules
desc: Zed reads one project instruction file (first match of .rules, .cursorrules, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md and similar) into agent context. Since v1.4.0 the on-demand Rules Library has been replaced by Skills, and old rules migrate to global skills or AGENTS.md.
deployment: not applicable — not a deployable product
pricing: not applicable — not commercial

name: AGiXT Adaptive Memory
desc: Open-source AI automation platform. Routes between short-term and long-term memory adaptively across any LLM provider; plugin system for storage backends. Memory managed at the instruction-management layer — task context, instruction state, conversation history as unified agent state.
deployment: Both (OSS self-hosted; agixt.com managed cloud implied)
pricing: OSS free (MIT); agixt.com offers hosted service but pricing not publicly listed

name: Agno (Phidata) Memory
desc: Agno (formerly Phidata). AgentStorage persists sessions to a DB; AgentMemory auto-classifies/store user preferences and conversation summaries. Single-line integrations with LanceDB, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant.
deployment: Both (self-hosted open source; Agno Cloud managed)
pricing: OSS free (Apache-2.0); Agno Cloud: usage-based, free tier; no per-event fees; no egress costs

name: AutoGen Memory
desc: AutoGen's memory layer: ListMemory chronological context plus teachable agents that vectorise corrections; integrates with Mem0/Zep rather than building deep memory natively. Microsoft AutoGen is in maintenance mode (community managed, bug and security fixes only), and Microsoft points new projects to Microsoft Agent Framework.
deployment: Both (OSS self-hosted Python; Azure AI Foundry managed runtime with GA Q1 2026)
pricing: OSS (MIT); no direct cost for library

name: Botpress LLMz
desc: Per-plan vector-DB storage quota + LLMz autonomous engine (in-session working memory) + Knowledge Base (semantic search over uploaded docs). Long-term user memory persists across sessions.
deployment: Both (OSS self-hosted; Botpress Cloud SaaS; private cloud option)
pricing: Free 500 msgs/mo; Plus $89/mo 1GB Vector DB; Team $495/mo 2GB; Enterprise custom

name: CrewAI Memory
desc: Memory subsystem inside the CrewAI orchestration framework; integrates with Mem0 for the long-term tier.
deployment: Both
pricing: Free + paid

name: DSPy History
desc: dspy.History primitive — typed field holding messages: list[dict] that slots into any Signature . No persistent memory of its own; purely a structured context-injection contract. DSPy's optimisation loop (MIPRO, BootstrapFewShot) treats historical turns as trainable few-shot structure.
deployment: Both (OSS self-hosted; dspy.ai cloud services if applicable)
pricing: OSS free (Apache-2.0); dspy.ai commercial services ~$110K ARR but pricing details not publicly listed

name: Flowise Memory
desc: Discontinued: Flowise (acquired by Workday, Aug 2025) was sunset in 2026 — code freeze 2026-07-29, GitHub repo archived 2026-08-13, end of life 2026-08-31. Was a visual LangChain canvas with LangChain-native memory nodes (Buffer, Buffer Window, Conversation Summary Buffer) backed by an internal chat_message DB table; Buffer Window kept the last K interactions, Summary Buffer compressed older turns
deployment: Both (OSS self-hosted; Flowise Cloud managed; air-gapped deployment supported)
pricing: discontinued — product sunset (EOL 2026-08-31); OSS code remains forkable under Apache-2.0

name: Google ADK Memory
desc: Google's Agent Development Kit. Session services: InMemory / Database / VertexAI. Long-term: InMemoryMemoryService or VertexAIMemoryBankService (uses Vertex AI Memory Bank Preview for persistent cross-session memory).
deployment: Both (ADK OSS self-hosted; one-command deploy to Google Cloud Agent Engine / Cloud Run / GKE)
pricing: ADK OSS free; Vertex AI Memory Bank and Agent Engine: consumption-based pay-per-use cloud pricing (serverless)

name: Haystack Memory (deepset)
desc: Haystack 2.x: InMemoryChatMessageStore (experimental) + ChatMessageRetriever + ChatMessageWriter components in declarative pipelines. Legacy: ConversationSummaryMemory with LLM-compressed rolling summaries. Memory is an explicit pipeline component with swappable backends.
deployment: Both (OSS self-hosted; Haystack Enterprise Platform: SaaS cloud, VPC, or on-prem)
pricing: OSS free (Apache-2.0); Haystack Enterprise Platform: custom licensing + runtime fees + optional expert services

name: Hermes Agent memory (Nous Research)
desc: Nous Research's open-source self-improving agent keeps an agent-curated MEMORY.md/USER.md notebook injected at session start, full-text (FTS5) search over past sessions that returns raw messages without LLM summarisation, and optional Honcho user modelling. Traction: ~254k GitHub stars; one of the most-starred agent projects of 2026.
deployment: searched not found
pricing: searched not found

name: Inngest AgentKit — Network State
desc: Memory as Network State — shared key-value store owned by the multi-agent network, readable by router / agents / tools. Persisted durably via Inngest infrastructure. Memory writes decoupled from response latency: agent responds immediately, background Inngest function handles DB write durably with retries.
deployment: Both (deploy AgentKit to preferred cloud provider; Inngest platform manages durable state)
pricing: Free tier; Pro; Enterprise custom; exact pricing not published — contact for enterprise

name: LangGraph Persistence
desc: Distinct from LangMem. Built-in checkpointer saves graph state per super-step (short-term, thread-scoped). Store System adds long-term hierarchical key-value memory across threads with optional vector search + TTL. Postgres / Mongo / Redis stores for production.
deployment: Both (LangGraph OSS self-hosted; LangSmith Deployment cloud managed or self-hosted)
pricing: OSS free (MIT); LangSmith Developer $0 (5k traces/mo, 1 seat); Plus $39/seat/mo (1 free small serverless deployment); deployments metered at $1/LSU by compute+m

name: LangMem (LangChain)
desc: First-class memory module inside LangChain — explicit cognitive-science-style typing of memories.
deployment: Both (LangSmith cloud managed + self-hosted Kubernetes; LangGraph Platform cloud or self-hosted)
pricing: OSS library free; LangSmith (observability/platform) Free 5k traces/mo; Plus $39/mo; Enterprise custom.

name: Langflow Memory
desc: Agent component has built-in chat memory enabled by default, keyed by session ID. Custom session IDs isolate per-user history. Bundled Mem0 + Redis integrations for external memory layers.
deployment: OSS self-hosted (all major clouds); DataStax cloud deprecated; IBM acquisition path unclear
pricing: OSS free (MIT); DataStax Langflow cloud was free tier + paid

name: Lindy AI Memory
desc: Memory is a file explorer for what Lindy knows: files it creates or uses, files users upload, skills (.skills/ folders with SKILL.md) and durable knowledge in a .memory/ area. Scoped Personal (owner only), Team (admins edit, members read-only) and System (read-only); every save is versioned and restorable.
deployment: Managed cloud only (SaaS)
pricing: Free: $50 in credits for 7 days, no card; Team $29.99/user/mo (3,000 credits, extra $10 per 1,000); Enterprise custom
type: Selective KV memory injected into prompt

name: LlamaIndex Memory
desc: Two-tier model: ChatMessage FIFO queue with overflow flushed into long-term Memory Block objects. Memory class replacing older ChatMemoryBuffer.
deployment: Both
pricing: Free + paid

name: Mastra Memory
desc: TypeScript-first agent framework. Default memory: LibSQL store + on-device fastembed-js for semantic recall.
deployment: Both
pricing: Free + paid
license: Apache-2.0 (core; ee/ dirs under source-available Mastra Enterprise License)

name: OpenAI Agents SDK Memory
desc: OpenAI's agent SDK. Sessions for working context within an agent loop; RunContextWrapper for structured persistent state. April 2026 update added categorised long-term memory: project / user / policy. Long-term tier typically backed by external vector DBs (Pinecone, etc.).
deployment: Both (OSS library self-hosted; relies on OpenAI or Azure OpenAI API endpoints; no dedicated SDK hosting)
pricing: SDK OSS free; pay for OpenAI API model usage at standard token pricing (e.g. GPT-5.4: $2.50/$15 per M tokens)

name: Praison Memory
desc: PraisonAI multi-agent framework memory: zero-dependency default (memory=True), short/long-term and file memory, DB persistence (Postgres/SQLite/Redis/Mongo etc.), graph memory, and a Claude memory-tool integration.
deployment: searched not found
pricing: free / open source (MIT)

name: Pydantic-AI + Hindsight
desc: Pydantic-AI ships no native persistent memory; agents start fresh each run. Long-term memory typically added via third-party integration (e.g. Hindsight) using tools + auto-injected memory instructions.
deployment: Both
pricing: OSS

name: Pydantic-AI MemoryTool
desc: Pydantic AI Harness ships a Memory capability: a MEMORY.md notebook plus extra Markdown notes, exposed via write/read/delete/search memory tools and auto-injected into context; backends InMemory, File, SQLite, Postgres with per-user namespaces. Provider memory tools (e.g. Anthropic) remain available as builtin tools.
deployment: Both (OSS self-hosted; Pydantic Logfire cloud for observability)
pricing: OSS free (MIT for pydantic-ai); pay for model provider API usage; Pydantic Logfire observability has separate pricing

name: Relevance AI Memory
desc: Two memory scopes: conversation metadata (KV per-conversation) and persistent memory (cross-session). Enabling metadata auto-adds Add/Read conversation metadata tools.
deployment: Managed cloud only (SaaS); multi-region on enterprise tier
pricing: Public pricing page now lists only Enterprise (custom actions/vendor credits; contact sales)

name: Retell AI
desc: Voice agents. Short-term context within call native; long-term memory via webhook integration to CRM / external DB. Cross-agent memory sharing in multi-agent setups.
deployment: Managed-only (Retell-hosted; Enterprise dedicated-server add-on; no self-host option listed)
pricing: Pay-as-you-go voice $0.07–0.31/min, chat from $0.002/msg, $10 free credits, 20 free concurrent calls (+$8/concurrent call/mo); Enterprise custom

name: Rivet Memory Node (Ironclad)
desc: Open-source visual AI programming environment. Memory is a first-class graph node: stores text block, supports stable IDs (saving same ID overwrites enabling updates), injects stored text into downstream nodes when relevant. Memory is designed and debugged visually.
deployment: Both (OSS desktop app or self-hosted; remote executor for cloud/production deployment)
pricing: OSS free (MIT)

name: Semantic Kernel Memory
desc: Microsoft Semantic Kernel's memory plugin (Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Plugins.Memory): a plug-in approach to long-term memory in the SK agent framework. Semantic Kernel's README now names Microsoft Agent Framework as the successor (maintenance mode).
deployment: Both (on-prem, containers, any cloud, or Azure AI Foundry managed)
pricing: OSS (MIT); no direct cost for library; pay only for Azure/model consumption when using managed Azure infrastructure

name: Spring AI ChatMemory
desc: Wraps conversation memory behind an Advisor abstraction. MessageWindowChatMemory default 20-msg sliding window (preserves system messages); pluggable ChatMemoryRepository backends (in-memory, JDBC, Cassandra, Neo4j). Memory injected as cross-cutting concern at the ChatClient level.
deployment: Both (on-prem, any cloud, or VMware Tanzu managed platform)
pricing: OSS free (Apache-2.0); Tanzu Spring Enterprise subscription available for commercial support

name: Stack AI
desc: Acquired by Asana (completed 2026-05-28); continues as its own product and brand. Connects enterprise knowledge sources (SharePoint, Confluence, Notion, Drive, DBs) as memory layer with access controls, versioning, citations. Agents query at runtime; no separate session/cross-session store.
deployment: Multi-tenant cloud, VPC, or on-premise (Enterprise)
pricing: Free $0 (500 runs/mo, 2 projects, 1 seat); Enterprise custom

name: Strands Agents Memory (AWS)
desc: AWS code-first agent framework. Multi-LLM (Bedrock, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI). Memory via Mem0 integration (ElastiCache for Valkey + Neptune Analytics) or Bedrock AgentCore Memory. Local default uses FAISS; OpenSearch for production.
deployment: Both (OSS self-hosted; AWS Bedrock AgentCore managed cloud)
pricing: Strands SDK OSS free; AgentCore Memory: short-term $1.00/GB ingested from 2026-10-06 (was $0.25/1k events); long-term $0.75/1k records-mo, $0.50/1k retrievals

name: Vapi (voice agents)
desc: Voice agents. Externalises memory from LLM into structured call state — variables rather than model recall — reducing hallucinations. Squad mode passes context across multi-agent assistant hand-offs in same call.
deployment: Both
pricing: Pay-as-you-go $0.05/min Vapi hosting with $5 free credit; Core $29/mo; Pro 10% of the hosting fee ($999/mo minimum); Premier custom

name: Voiceflow Memory
desc: Agent platform. Keeps a configurable window of recent turns (default 50, range 10–100) in the {vf_memory} variable; older turns are summarized rather than dropped. Chat projects can persist history indefinitely or clear it on tab close/refresh.
deployment: Managed-only
pricing: Free trial + usage-based billing for agencies/partners; business pricing on request

name: memory-lancedb-pro (OpenClaw plugin)
desc: Enhanced LanceDB memory plugin for OpenClaw that adds hybrid vector + BM25 retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, multi-scope isolation and a management CLI. Traction: ~4.5k stars; #21 in TeleAI Awesome-Agent-Memory
deployment: searched not found
pricing: searched not found

name: n8n AI Agent Memory
desc: Low-code workflow platform. AI Agent node ships with pluggable memory sub-graph: Simple Memory for development; Postgres/Redis for production; vector store nodes (Qdrant, Pinecone, MongoDB Atlas) for semantic recall.
deployment: Self-hosted (Docker / npm); cloud via n8n.cloud SaaS
pricing: Free self-hosted Community Edition; Cloud: Starter €20/mo; Pro €50/mo; Business $800/mo (40k executions)
license: Sustainable Use License + n8n Enterprise License (fair-code, source-available; n

name: smolagents Memory
desc: Hugging Face barebones agent framework. Memory lives as a Python list; no built-in persistence. Step callbacks let you mutate memory between steps. Persistence is left to the user — community proposals exist for "memory bank"-style additions.
deployment: Both (OSS self-hosted; Hugging Face Inference Endpoints / Enterprise Hub managed)
pricing: OSS free (Apache-2.0); Hugging Face Enterprise Hub starts at $20/user/mo for managed services

name: Acuvity (now Proofpoint)
desc: Acquired by Proofpoint (closed 2026-02-12). Runtime enforcement targeting memory poisoning, unauthorised execution, identity spoofing per the OWASP LLM threat list. Visibility/control over MCP servers and locally-installed AI tools — the infrastructure layer where memory is most exposed.
deployment: on-prem or cloud (Proofpoint enterprise deployment); agentless approach
pricing: enterprise pricing via Proofpoint (not public); contact sales

name: Enkrypt AI
desc: Applies guardrails at three points: (1) before write to vector DB, (2) before query reaches embedding model, (3) before response. Detects malicious instructions in stored memory before retrieval; scans for PII/PHI in/out. Text + image + voice modalities.
deployment: SaaS for self-serve tiers; Enterprise offers VPC / on-prem deployment
pricing: Explore free; Launch $149/mo ($134/mo annual); Scale $1,499/mo ($1,349/mo annual); Enterprise custom

name: HiddenLayer AISec Platform 2.0
desc: AI security platform with four modules: AI asset discovery, supply-chain/model integrity validation, continuous attack simulation, and runtime detection/response, including protection of agents and MCP-based systems.
deployment: Agentless, model-agnostic; connectors for cloud, CI/CD, SIEM/SOAR, API gateways, MLOps (specific SaaS/on-prem options not stated)
pricing: enterprise pricing; contact sales; no public pricing

name: Hyperconsciousness (hc)
desc: Developer-alpha encrypted, append-only knowledge store for humans and agents, with CLI/MCP access and scoped, expiring grants. Traction: Submitted via intake issue #181
deployment: searched not found
pricing: searched not found

name: Lakera Guard / Lakera Red
desc: Acquired by Check Point Software (completed by 2025-11-11); being folded into Check Point's AI security platform. Screens every prompt, response, and retrieved document for indirect prompt injection — primary vector for memory poisoning. Treats memory as untrusted: anything written to or read from memory is adversarial until proven clean. Lakera Red provides "Agent Breaker" gamified red-teaming.
deployment: REST API (SaaS cloud) or self-hosted Enterprise deployment
pricing: Developer: free (10K API calls/mo); Pro: contact sales (higher volume + advanced detection)

name: Mem0 Security / OpenMemory
desc: Commercial Mem0 ships SOC 2 / HIPAA, zero-trust access controls, BYOK encryption, real-time monitoring, audit logs, workspace governance as defaults. OpenMemory is the local self-hosted variant (Docker + FastAPI + Postgres + Qdrant) for privacy-first deployments.
deployment: SaaS cloud; Enterprise VPC; OpenMemory hosted or self-hosted (Docker)
pricing: Hobby free (10K adds/1K retrievals/mo); Starter $19/mo; Pro $249/mo; Enterprise custom

name: Microsoft Agent Governance Toolkit
desc: Cross-Model Verification Kernel (CMVK) requires majority-voting agreement across multiple model calls before a memory-influenced action. Agent OS package intercepts every action (memory included) at sub-millisecond latency. MIT licensed.
deployment: library/SDK integration; multi-language (Python TypeScript Rust Go .NET); LangChain/CrewAI/Google ADK integrations
pricing: free / open source (MIT)

name: OWASP Agent Memory Guard
desc: Open-source runtime defense. Enforces YAML policies on every memory read/write. SHA-256 baselines detect tampering, injection, sensitive-data leakage, protected-key modification, rapid-change anomalies. Forensic snapshots + rollback. Reference impl for OWASP ASI06 (Memory Poisoning).
deployment: local deployment; Python; run against local memory stores
pricing: free / open source

name: Zep — governance posture
desc: Bi-temporal knowledge graph preserves full lineage of every stored fact — every memory write traceable and auditable by graph schema, not bolted-on logging. SOC 2 Type II; HIPAA BAA available; BYOK + VPC-isolated deployment for data residency.
deployment: SaaS cloud; self-hosted (Graphiti OSS); Enterprise: BYOC VPC
pricing: Free 10k credits/mo; Flex ~$125/mo (50k credits); Flex Plus ~$375/mo (200k credits); Enterprise custom (third-party tracker, prices inconsistent — confirm on ge

name: AgentOps
desc: When Mem0 is connected, gains Memory Operation Timeline, Search Analytics, Memory Growth tracking, Error Tracking per memory call. Standalone, records context at each step but doesn't analyse memory quality.
deployment: SaaS cloud; SDK integration into agent code
pricing: free tier; Pro/Enterprise pricing not publicly listed; contact sales
